Data Structure Basics and Algorithm Complexity
likelyQuestions: Give two representations of graphs and define in-degree and out-degree; illustrate Dijkstra's algorithm with an example.
Implement PUSH and POP on a stack using an array and analyse the complexity; list stack applications.
Insert the given keys into an empty BST and show the result of deleting the root; write the BST search/insert algorithm.
Define data structure; differentiate linear and non-linear data structures and discuss two in detail.
How is an array represented in memory? Differentiate row-major and column-major order and find the address of the given element.
Write an algorithm to insert a node at the end of a singly linked list; compare singly and circular linked lists.
Write insertion sort / selection sort with an example and analyse its complexity.
Define hashing and explain why it is needed.
Differentiate a queue and a priority queue; implement a priority queue using linked lists.
What is a minimum spanning tree? Explain Prim's and Kruskal's algorithms with examples; illustrate topological sort.
